decisions.reason: Reject for visible crowd composition and gesture differences. The source photograph depicts an uneven chamber crowd, with conspicuous raised-arm gestures around the rear/right floor seating, and sparse separated balcony figures around the central empty chair banks. The raw substantially rearranges the lower crowd into mostly orderly seated yellow figures with arms lowered on desks and two central standing figures; its balcony adds a near-continuous front row of roughly ten yellow heads. Matching chamber/aisle/desk composition in the actually viewed larger original supports these visible source differences; no appearance was inferred from the filename. Preserve the original people distribution and discernible raised arms while transforming bodies. Specific evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: the exact tiny card cannot resolve each distant person's hair, facial hair, eyewear or tiny facial expression; no claim of exact hair matching and no rejection solely for that unreadable detail. The yellow green-eyed mascot identity, dark formal clothes, visible compact collar transitions, warm chamber light, photographic backing, tilted dark frame and overlapping cream note with two upper mark rows were inspected. No floating collar or white belly patch was seen. Full raw plus white/cyan/alpha show no visible interior hole, transparency or lost original backing.
